rootCause: Every scoped row executes an interpreted 64-round SHA-256 Mongo expression before the count facet. This CPU cost scales with the population, not page size. The key depends only on immutable ObjectId job/applicant values.

alternatives.option: Remove hash check or validate only a page
alternatives.decision: Rejected: forged records would affect totals; weakens accepted integrity.

alternatives.option: Higher timeout or permanent positive-result cache
alternatives.decision: Rejected: hides cost or creates invalidation/revocation and mutation trust problems.

Not selected: requires full writer coverage, trusted proof semantics for legacy and direct database edits, rollout/backfill and independent verification. No schema or migration needed in selected design.
Rejected: adds scripting deployment dependency and deprecated operator surface.
Retains interpreted per-row rounds and uncertain 1000-row performance; baseline kept for exact comparison.

alternatives.option: Bounded request-local SHA-256 verification using existing Node crypto, then database joins/facet restricted by validated row IDs
alternatives.decision: Selected. Same digest algorithm; no persistent marker/cache, no schema, no backfill and no source-data duplication.

correctness.trustBoundary: Within existing owner/org/settings authorization transaction, stream only owned Shortlist _id/jobId/candidateId/applicationId tuples. Compute canonical SHA-256 with the lifecycle key generator; keep only matching row IDs. Mongo then rechecks owner/job/application/immutable tuple/original consent/status validity before exact counts and pagination. No source evidence or private names in the integrity pass. All operations use the same snapshot session.
correctness.writerCoverage: No marker/writer change; service submissions, retained legacy links and raw malformed records are independently checked on every request. Forged valid-looking hashes fail even if stored via raw collection writes.
correctness.revocation: Accepted actor/org/membership/settings and batched page Job/Application fences retained, including transaction retries. No cross-request authorization or identity cache.
correctness.compatibility: API response/parameters, ordering, evidence/status authorities and five-second budget remain. Old native expression remains available for baseline/regression measurement; production supplies the validated ID allowlist.
correctness.boundedWork: At most 10,001 tuples streamed in batches of 256 and at most 10,000 verified IDs retained. If the owner pool exceeds 10,000 tuples or the shared five-second validation/query deadline expires, fail explicitly with 503 and no truncated success/total. This capacity ceiling is documented, tested and not hidden as pagination.
correctness.migration: None. No persisted fields, backfills, index operations, package changes or production mutations.

validationPlan: Compare exact baseline/current results on 261 and 1000 linked records with malformed rows, including plausible forged SHA keys.
Sequential isolated Mongo fixture; p50/p95 HTTP, explains, docs/keys examined, Node memory and timeouts; simultaneous read and mixed lifecycle workloads.
Focused privacy/ownership/consent/withdrawal/notification/public discovery/Analytics regressions, affected Angular tests and production build.
Targeted real Angular -> production Express routes -> disposable Mongo smoke, then formatting, cleanup, compiler/syntax/whitespace and baseline-index preservation checks.
refinement: Initial measurements found database per-row lookups remained dominant at 1000 records. Extend the same bounded integrity pass with one batch owned-Job query and one batch owned-Application query for minimal tuples/consent/status. Reuse extracted accepted genuine/canonicalRow predicates, then pass fully validated shortlist IDs to a simple Mongo facet. Hydrate only the returned page with two batched view queries. All reads share the authorization snapshot and five-second validation/count budget; existing page fences remain. At most 10000 provisional rows and source maps are held, never submitted evidence. No persisted marker or source projection.
finalFlow: Bounded minimal shortlist identity stream -> native Node SHA-256 -> batched original-owner Job/Application tuple+consent checks using accepted genuine/canonical predicates -> exact DB facet over validated IDs -> two page-only view hydrations -> retained access fences; one snapshot session throughout.
